duplicate.title: {{name}} is already loaded.
duplicate.body: Loading it again adds a second copy of the same model to the scene.

large.banner: Large IFC detected. This model may take several minutes to process. The viewer will remain usable while it loads.
large.memoryWarning: Very large IFCs can exceed the browser's WebAssembly memory limit (around 2.5 GB of IFC in practice). If a load fails, splitting the model by discipline or storey usually helps.

errors.titleMany: None of these files can be loaded
errors.INVALID_MIME: The file type is not recognised as IFC.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_IFC_VERSION: IFC schema not supported. Accepted: IFC2x3, IFC4, IFC4x3.
errors.CORRUPTED_FILE: Not a valid IFC header — the file may be corrupted.
errors.READ_FAILED: The file could not be read. It may have been moved, or access to it was revoked.
errors.UNKNOWN: Unexpected error while checking the file.

active.checkingSchema: Checking IFC schema and file integrity

mascot.label: Bimo, the IFC Viewer mascot
mascot.hello: Hi, I’m Bimo! Drop an IFC and I’ll show you around.
mascot.tip1: Drop an .ifc file and I’ll open it right in your browser.
mascot.tip2: Nothing gets uploaded. Your model stays on your machine.
mascot.tip3: Try the validator. I love a clean IDS report.
mascot.blogHello: I’ll keep you company while you read.
mascot.blogTip1: Want to try this? Open the viewer and drop your own IFC.
mascot.blogTip2: Questions? Use the AI button on this article to ask your assistant about it.
mascot.blogTip3: Tip: the table of contents jumps straight to any section.
mascot.blogDone: You made it to the end! Ready to try it on your own model?
mascot.welcome: You’re in! I’ll keep every validation run safe for you.
mascot.signin: Welcome back! Sign in and I’ll fetch your history.
mascot.signup: Create your account and I’ll remember every model you check.
mascot.proPitch: Pro keeps your history, syncs your rules and puts your logo on reports.
mascot.proLater: No worries, the free viewer stays free.
mascot.newsPrompt: I only write when there’s something worth reading.
mascot.emailError: Hmm, that didn’t go through. Try again?
mascot.ebookThanks: Enjoy the handbook! It’s downloading now.

notFound.title: This page wandered off
notFound.body: I looked everywhere and couldn’t find it. It may have moved, or the link has a typo.

unsupported.title: This one isn’t supported yet
unsupported.body: Your browser or this file type can’t do this yet. Try a recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.

docs.title: Let me show you around
docs.body: Guides, reference and examples, written to be followed step by step.

offline.title: You’re offline
offline.body: I’ll wait here. Anything already open keeps working; the rest comes back with the connection.

error.title: That didn’t work
error.body: It’s on our side, not yours. Try again, and if it keeps happening, tell us what you were doing.

empty.title: It’s a little empty
empty.body: Once you add something, it will show up here.

comingSoon.title: I’m building this right now
comingSoon.body: It isn’t ready yet, but it’s on its way. Check back soon.

success.title: All set!
success.body: Everything went through. You’re good to go.
